source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης Πατριάρχης Ιεροσολύμων»

attestations.note: One sentence: «Ο Άγιος Ιωάννης ήταν από τους πρώτους Πατριάρχες Ιεροσολύμων και απεβίωσε ειρηνικά» — he was one of the first patriarchs of Jerusalem, and he died peacefully. The page gives no year, no number in the succession, no act and no hymn, so this folder carries no `dates`; the see is the only thing that distinguishes him, which is why the display name carries it. He is not the John whom the same page keeps as the hermit of the well on the same day, nor the John of the Ladder above him in the same list.
